name: Tuna, White Bean, and Zucchini Salad

ingredients.name: freshly ground black pepper, plus more for serving
extra-virgin olive oil, plus more for serving
butter beans, drained and rinsed, and patted dry
oil-packed tuna, drained and flaked into large pieces

instructions.primary_message: Using a vegetable peeler or mandoline, shave zucchini lengthwise into long, thin ribbons.
In a colander set over a large bowl, gently toss zucchini and 1 teaspoon salt until evenly coated. Let sit until slightly softened, about 15 minutes. Discard liquid in bowl.
Meanwhile, in a large bowl, whisk shallot, lemon zest and juice, garlic, herbs, pepper, and remaining 1 teaspoon salt; let sit for 15 minutes. Whisking constantly, slowly drizzle in olive oil.

Place zucchini in a salad spinner and spin until dry, about 30 seconds; discard liquid. (Alternatively, pat zucchini dry with paper towels or a clean kitchen towel.) Add zucchini, butter beans, and tuna to shallot mixture and gently toss until evenly coated. Cover and let stand at room temperature until flavors meld, about 30 minutes. Transfer to a platter and top with additional oil, pepper, and herbs. Serve with lemon wedges on the side.

schema_metadata.keywords: zucchini salad, butter bean salad, tuna salad, raw zucchini salad, zucchini tuna salad

description: This zucchini, butter bean, and tuna salad pairs tender raw zucchini with creamy beans, fresh herbs, and a punchy lemon-shallot dressing.
notes:
Total time, including resting: 50 min.

Optional or for serving: 1/4 cup fresh lemon juice from 2 medium lemons, plus wedges for serving

Make-ahead and storage: Dressing can be made up to 4 days in advance and refrigerated in an airtight container.
Leftovers can be refrigerated in an airtight container for up to 4 days.
author: Laila Ibrahim
